audience: marketers who run referral and giveaway campaigns with ReferralHero

useCases.title: Show the leaderboard of a campaign
useCases.text: The AI reads the top 10 to 100 subscribers of a campaign with referral counts, points and position. It can also list your campaigns with their subscriber counts.

useCases.title: Find a subscriber and see who they referred
useCases.text: The AI finds a subscriber by email, referral code or name, reads their points, position and fraud risk level, and lists the people they referred.

useCases.title: Check which rewards are pending or sent
useCases.text: The AI lists the rewards unlocked across a campaign with status (sent, resent, canceled, pending, flagged), value and subscriber, and the reward setup of the campaign.

useCases.title: Add subscribers, points or purchases
useCases.text: The AI adds a subscriber to a campaign, adds points to one, or records a purchase for a subscriber so revenue-based rewards count it. Each points call adds again.

useCases.title: Qualify referrals and update reward status
useCases.text: The AI marks a referral as qualified or unqualified, for example after fraud or a refund, and sets an unlocked reward to sent, resent or canceled. Marking sent can email the subscriber.
